answer_1.quote: We evaluate MODULAR PLURALISM with six open-source and proprietary LLMs ... on four datasets and six tasks spanning the three types of pluralism. ... Overton ... the black-box LLM serves as a multi-document summarization system to synthesize diverse viewpoints into a coherent response.
answer_1.outputs: generated textual responses (answers, summaries, opinion selections)

answer_2.quote: We employ an NLI model to evaluate what percentage of values identified in VK are reflected in LLM responses... We use the Jensen‑Shannon distance to measure the distributional differences... We evaluate Steerable w/ Value Kaleidoscope using Accuracy (Acc), Balanced Accuracy (BAcc), and Macro‑averaged F1-score (MaF).

answer_3.quote: We employ human evaluation and GPT‑4 LLM‑as‑a‑judge evaluation. A similar evaluation is conducted with GPT‑4 as a judge. We use the prompt "Please evaluate which of the two responses better reflects pluralistic values given a situation..."

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, 5 annotators are employed to reflect on 100 response pairs: "Please reflect on whether the two responses reflect pluralistic values with regard to the given situation." A tie is also allowed.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which of two responses better reflects pluralistic values, or indicate a tie.
